user.title: Connect to PyPowerwall
user.description: Enter the connection details for your PyPowerwall proxy and InfluxDB instance.

data_description.pypowerwall_url: Base URL of your pypowerwall proxy, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8675
data_description.influxdb_url: Base URL of your InfluxDB instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8086
data_description.timezone: Your timezone in IANA format, e.g. America/New_York
data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch new data, in seconds. Applies to every sensor, switch and the firmware entity. Lower values update faster but put more load on pypowerwall and InfluxDB.
data_description.temperature_unit: The unit Powerwall temperatures are shown in. The gateway reports Celsius and the sensors convert to this unit.
data_description.show_strings: Create a power sensor for each solar string, using the /strings endpoint of pypowerwall.
data_description.allow_controls: Enable controlling your Powerwall (e.g. changing operating mode or reserve) from Home Assistant. Only avalible for v1r or cloud configurations!

controls.title: Powerwall controls
controls.description: Controls are enabled. Enter the control secret configured on your pypowerwall proxy.

data_description.control_secret: The value of PW_CONTROL_SECRET in your pypowerwall Docker environment.

start_max_backup.name: Start Max Backup
start_max_backup.description: Starts a max backup that keeps the battery reserved for backup for the given time. Works in seconds and does not use or change the Max backup until entity. Needs Allow controls on and a v1r-mode pypowerwall server.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long max backup should run, in seconds (minimum 60).

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: Which Powerwall Dashboard instance to use. Only needed when more than one instance has controls enabled.

stop_max_backup.name: Stop Max Backup
stop_max_backup.description: Cancels the current max backup. The request is always sent; if the gateway refuses it (for example nothing is running), the reason is shown as an error.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: Which Powerwall Dashboard instance to use. Only needed when more than one instance has controls enabled.

no_control_instance.message: No Powerwall Dashboard instance has controls enabled. Turn on Allow controls in the integration options.

multiple_instances.message: More than one Powerwall Dashboard instance has controls enabled. Choose one with the Instance field.

unknown_instance.message: The selected Powerwall Dashboard instance does not exist.

controls_not_enabled.message: Controls are not enabled for the selected Powerwall Dashboard instance.

max_backup_until_not_set.message: Set Max backup until to a future date and time before turning on Max backup.

max_backup_until_too_soon.message: Max backup until must be at least 1 minute from now.

max_backup_until_too_far.message: Max backup until is further away than the gateway allows.
